publisher: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, Inc.
document_title: IEEE Standard for SystemVerilog--Unified Hardware Design, Specification, and Verification Language
notes: IEEE and Accellera identify IEEE Std 1800-2023 as the active SystemVerilog language reference standard.
IEEE offers the standard without charge through its account-based Get Program, but its automated endpoint rejected acquisition in this environment.
The local bytes were therefore acquired from the recorded public mirror and retain that mirror's page-margin stamp.
The raw PDF is a local cache and is not committed to Git.
No spec2lean pipeline phase was run during acquisition.
